## About Michael
I was raised in Blowing Rock and am the son of an accountant and a librarian. My wife, Suzanne, and I live in Gaston County.
I had the honor of serving as Chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party and, at President Trump’s request, as Chairman of the Republican National Committee during the 2024 election cycle.
I am proud to be President Trump’s endorsed candidate to represent the great state of North Carolina in the U.S. Senate.
## The Issues
Enact the Trump Agenda in the U.S. Senate
I am committed to advancing President Trump’s America First agenda as the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina.
Make North Carolina Safe Again
As your U.S. Senator, I’ll work with President Trump to restore law and order, roll-back weak Democrat policies like cashless bail, and make North Carolina safe again.
I 100% support President Trump securing the border and deporting the millions of criminal illegal aliens that Joe Biden and Roy Cooper allowed into this country.
America’s economic strength depends on reliable, affordable energy and reining in Washington’s reckless spending.
Protect Our Conservative Values
I will fight to defend the 2nd Amendment, protect life, support our law enforcement, and keep radical woke ideology out of schools.
I have worked with the Trump administration to deliver billions in disaster relief aid to North Carolina.
